reserveReview.rationale: Historical composition remains the 2026-09-04 source snapshot: USCC 87.7%, USTB 11.7%, pUSD 0.6%. On 2026-10-03, the exact nBASIS positions API identified pUSD, USDC and USDT balances as liquidAssets with no pending transactions; Nest liquidity documentation identifies these on-chain reserves as available for instant conversion when sufficient. Immediate refers only to the scoped idle token balances, not bank USD settlement, underlying fund redemption, whole-vault withdrawal or stressed value. Zero-percent keyed USDC/USDT rows supply live metadata only and do not refresh historical weights. USCC and USTB liquidity remains unknown because business-day schedules and limited protocol liquidity do not establish an unconditional calendar maximum.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Nest current nBASIS directory and positions/last-price-update APIs fetched 2026-09-04; settled positions normalized to reported vault NAV
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every material active API position is identified. USCC remains an identified exogenous fund share rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency; positive liquid balances below the adapter's one-decimal display threshold round out of the published slice list.
